key_insight: Lighthouse RL boosts sample efficiency in analog circuit optimization by resetting RL episodes from previously discovered high-performing states instead of always starting from scratch.
engineering_relevance: This makes black-box circuit sizing more practical by improving success rates and reducing expensive simulation calls, with a plug-and-play strategy for other RL-based optimizers.
method: Train RL agents for circuit sizing as usual.
Identify high-performing configurations during training as “lighthouses.”
Restart new episodes from these strategic reset points to guide exploration toward promising regions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports gains on a 2D benchmark and two analog circuits, including up to 1.72x faster optimization, 100% success vs. 0–87% for baselines, and 75% extrapolation success vs. 0–50% for comparators.
watch_item: Performance depends on discovering useful lighthouses during training, so the approach may be less effective if early exploration fails to find strong reset states.
paper_title: Lighthouse RL: Sample-Efficient Circuit Optimization via Strategic Reset Points
